about: Checked photos per place for the place page (photo layout 'mix': the hero shows the place itself, then a food row and the inside / the outside): food, drinks, the interior, staff at work or a guest-free exterior only, from the place's own website, its own public Instagram profile embed (no login) or a free licence; every photo checked by eye for guests, text graphics, posters, logos, menus and collages. Self-hosted under img/places/<city>/<id>/ (scripts/apply_photo_picks.py). only = this set replaces older photos and the hotlinked og:image; hold = only photos with people exist (neutral placeholder).
